Industry Overview
The BioLife Science sector continues to drive innovation across healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals and research. Facilities within this sector demand highly controlled environments, reliable utility infrastructure and consistent operational performance to support research, development and manufacturing activities. As regulatory and technological advancement evolve, facility reliability and environmental control have become increasingly important to long-term success.
